reason: I like being first, and a free pilot that moves fast is my kind of thing. But my risk committee won't put an unaudited startup proxy in the path of customer trades when the identity check runs on a passport registry the same founder started. I'd take the intro call, but I'm not signing a letter of intent with a price on it this month.
objection: The vendor wrote the identity standard and sells the gate that enforces it. If AINRA is the only passport it reads today, my agent controls depend on one small company grading its own homework, with no SOC 2 and no other customer to call.
would_change_my_mind: Gate checking agents against a Know-Your-Agent standard the founder doesn't control, or AINRA handed to an independent body. With that I'd run the design-partner pilot in shadow mode right away.
